name: Shorts Factory
description: Create Studio presets for founder-led short-form video and audio: founder story reels, feature demos, weekly changelog videos, myth-busters, and podcast teasers.
author: REX

pipelines.title: Founder story Reel (9:16, 45s)
pipelines.style: Hook in the first 2 seconds, first-person founder voice, punchy on-screen text, bold high-contrast visuals.
pipelines.description: Why I built this: problem, struggle, turning point, invitation.
pipelines.brief: Tell the founder story behind this product: the painful problem, the failed alternatives, the insight, and an invitation to try it.

pipelines.title: Feature demo Short (9:16, 30s)
pipelines.style: Problem → feature → outcome. One idea per scene. Clean product-UI style visuals.
pipelines.description: Showcase one feature with a concrete before/after.
pipelines.brief: Show off this feature with a concrete before/after:

pipelines.title: Weekly changelog video (16:9, 60s)
pipelines.style: Upbeat, scannable, one change per scene with a benefit-led headline.
pipelines.description: Turn this week's shipped changes into a video update.
pipelines.brief: Turn these shipped changes into a weekly product update video:

pipelines.title: Myth vs. fact carousel video (1:1, 30s)
pipelines.style: Alternating 'Myth' and 'Fact' title cards, crisp contrast, confident tone.
pipelines.description: Bust 3 myths in your niche; great for LinkedIn.
pipelines.brief: Bust the 3 most common myths in this product's niche.

pipelines.title: Podcast teaser (audio, 60s)
pipelines.style: Cold open with the most surprising line, then a fast summary and a CTA to listen.
pipelines.description: A 60-second audio teaser for an episode.
pipelines.brief: Write a 60-second teaser for an episode about:
